source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: When a **PALADIN SQUAD** unit of yours is picked to fight, any of its attacks whose Strength is below the target's Toughness add 1 to the **Wound roll**.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 273 combat readings of Detachment rules (every record of the class not withheld otherwise, each time) wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

effects.condition: attack Strength lower than target Toughness
